_doc: Tier-1 script-mode fixture proving the diff_framework harness can run gem-dependent NON-server fixtures. JSON parity-by-parser-round-trip: same app.rb runs JSON::Ext::Parser on both runtimes — rubyrs loads the flori-json-cext parser.bundle, CRuby loads `json/ext` from stdlib. Both expose the same JSON::Ext::Parser API; the script invokes it and puts the results for byte-diff. Full ADR-0026-v2 menu item 2 (pure-Ruby JSON canon + _json_native accel) is a separate ~1–2 week landing; this fixture validates that the framework hosts the surface.
name: json_smoke
